newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Zuellig unit to buy pharmaceutical plant.
newsitem.headline: Zuellig unit to buy pharmaceutical plant.

text.p: Zuellig New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday that its subsidiary, PSM Holdings, had announced the purchase of the Merck Sharp & Dohme pharmaceutical manufacturing plant in Plunket Ave, Wiri.
PSM will spend NZ$3 million on further process and equipment improvements.
Zuellig also advised that it had finalised its programme to realise "properties held for sale" with the disposal of its 550 Te Rapa Road, Hamilton property.
This property was sold for $1.4 million (book value $1.75 million) and the sale proceeds would be utilised to acquire the pharmaceutical manufacturing facility for PSM, Zuellig said.
